$comment: False-positive registry for the secret scan. Every entry states WHY the pattern is not a credential.
A secret scan with a blanket allowlist is decoration; this one is narrow -- entries are (file, rule)
pairs, so a NEW finding in an already-registered file still fails. The strict scan in
scripts/run-secret-scan.mjs has no allowlist at all and rejects credential-shaped material anywhere.
If you need to add an entry, the reason must name what the value actually is.

entries.reason: Source-bound validator/self-test. The connection string is the LOCALHOST pattern the validator itself searches for; it is a detection pattern, not a credential.

Deployment template. The file exists to show operators the shape of each variable; its connection string carries a placeholder credential pointing at localhost, not a secret. Any AWS/GitHub/Slack/Stripe key or private key in this path is still rejected by the strict scan, which has no allowlist.
